source_data.age: **_Age._** Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.
source_data.alignment: **_Alignment._** Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and the worst are found among them.
source_data.asi_desc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your ability scores each increase by 1.
source_data.desc:
## Human Traits
It's hard to make generalizations about humans, but your human character has these traits.
source_data.languages: **_Languages._** You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: Orc curses, Elvish musical expressions, Dwarvish military phrases, and so on.
source_data.name: Human
source_data.size: **_Size._** Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
source_data.speed_desc: **_Speed._** Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

## Human Traits
It's hard to make generalizations about humans, but your human character has these traits.
en.name: Human

ru.description:
**Тип существа:** Гуманоид

**Размер:** Средний (около 4–7 футов ростом) или Маленький (около 2–4 футов ростом), выбирается при выборе этого вида

**Скорость:** 30 футов

Как человек, вы обладаете следующими особыми чертами.

**Находчивость.** Вы получаете героическое вдохновение каждый раз, когда завершаете долгий отдых.

**Умелость.** Вы получаете владение одним навыком на ваш выбор.

**Универсальность.** Вы получаете одну черту происхождения на ваш выбор (см. «Черты»). Рекомендуется черта «Умелый».
ru.name: Человек
